title: ReJoin
description: Instantly reconnect to your last multiplayer server after a kick or crash with one keypress. No more navigating through the server list or remembering IP addresses. Just press the key and you're back in the game.
body:
## ReJoin

Ever get kicked from your favorite server and have to click through the entire server list just to get back? ReJoin eliminates that entirely. As soon as you disconnect, it remembers where you were. One keypress or automatic retry and you are reconnecting with exponential backoff.

### What it does
- **Auto-reconnect** -- detects disconnects and reconnects automatically with configurable delay and retry limits
- **Live ping HUD** -- shows your current ping in the corner, color-coded green/yellow/red
- **Kick reason filter** -- optionally skip reconnect if you were banned or kicked for a specific reason
- **Keybind toggle** -- press R (rebindable) to manually trigger a reconnect at any time

### How to use
- Default keybind: **R** (rebindable in Controls)
- Config via Mod Menu -> ReJoin
- HUD appears automatically in the top-left corner during multiplayer

### Compatibility
Client-side only, works on any server. No server mod required.

## Changelog
### v1.1.0
- Re-added Minecraft 1.21.11 support.
### v1.0.0
- Initial release: auto-reconnect on disconnect/kick (with backoff) + a connection/ping HUD.
